idea-plugin.name: slop-chop
idea-plugin.description: Chop AI writing tells in Markdown, plain text, and the comments of source files. The plugin runs the local slop-chop binary as a language server through LSP4IJ: tells surface as diagnostics. In Markdown and plain text a code action chops the document in place. In a source file only comment text is read and each fixable tell gets its own quick fix. Install the binary and put it on your PATH first (brew install dcadolph/tap/slop-chop or go install github.com/dcadolph/slop-chop@latest). See slop-chop.com.
